summary: Golf tournament scoring app: add gross score totals per golfer, replace golfer-count dropdown with manual numeric entry (1–64), and keep Tournament Title blank.

existing_features.title: In the score entry step, display a per-golfer gross total (sum of entered hole scores) after that golfer’s scores are entered.
Replace the "Number of Golfers" dropdown in the event setup form with a manual numeric input constrained to an integer between 1 and 64 inclusive.
Default the Tournament Title field to be blank and do not auto-fill a fallback title when the user leaves it empty.

When the event title is blank, ensure the leaderboard and PDF export do not render an empty title line (omit the title heading/print title or substitute a non-title-safe fallback only for document metadata).

new_feature_requests.summary: Display a gross score total after each golfer's scores are entered.
Change number of golfers input from a dropdown to a manual numeric entry constrained to 1–64.
Leave the Tournament Title blank (no prefilled/default title).
